status_definitions.verified_catalog: Official catalog, searchable data-product list, or agency REST service directory identified and its current primary page/metadata observed. Does not mean API or dataset collection is integrated.
status_definitions.official_page_only: An official agency identifies the catalog or data program, but the catalog endpoint has not been successfully inspected in this phase.
status_definitions.unresolved: No sufficiently verified official catalog or data-program page located yet.
